Why there is no price on the page

A share price is the exchange’s and your broker’s number. A fund NAV is the manager’s number, published through channels such as MUFAP. Copying those feeds onto a public page raises a data-use question this site does not need to settle, and a stale copied price is worse than none. Use the broker to trade. Use the app, once you are signed in, for charts and a ledger.

What a public page can honestly do is teach the paperwork: which report to open, which events change your quantity, and which events are only cash.

Common questions

Are these all the PSX symbols?

No. A page for every ticker, generated from one template, would be a pile of thin duplicates. These notes are ones people ask about often, written as themselves.

Can I trade from here?

No. Orders go through a licensed broker. This site does not open accounts and does not send orders.

Where do I track a holding?

In the app, after you sign in, with the contract note beside you. The guides explain FIFO, dividends, and reconciliation.
